name: Sardines & sardinellas
description: Sardine (Sardina pilchardus), sardinellas (Sardinella aurita, S. maderensis) and anchovy (Engraulis encrasicolus) - the small clupeid plankton-eaters that school in enormous shoals and feed the birds, the big pelagics and the purse-seine fleet. Functional group pooling the source's sardine and sardinelles compartments: both are small filter-feeding planktivores (the source noted sardine is the one fish group that feeds entirely outside the Banc); pooled here to fit this atlas's 25-node ceiling.
